issues.description: Method getStockIngredients in class de.tum.cit.ase.Stock has different return types across the template and the solution. In the template repository (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) the method signature declares: public List<StockIngredient> getStockIngredients() (returns java.util.List<StockIngredient>). In the solution repository (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) the corresponding method declares: public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() (returns StockIngredient[]). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about the intended API (array vs. List) and can lead to compilation or integration problems when students follow one artifact and compare to the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the return type of getStockIngredients in both repositories. Prefer changing the template method to return StockIngredient[] to match the solution and the existing setStockIngredients usage (which accepts StockIngredient[]). Concretely: in the template change the signature to public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() and have it return this.stockIngredients; or alternatively update the solution to return List<StockIngredient> and update setStockIngredients and other call sites accordingly. Ensure both template and solution use the same signature so students see a consistent API.
